senses.sense_definition: In staat om vaardigheden en kennis op een effectieve en bekwame manier toe te passen.

examples.text: Hij is een uiterst <w>kundig</w> onderzoeker die al vele complexe problemen heeft opgelost.

target_lang_translations.en: He is an extremely <w>capable</w> researcher who has already solved many complex problems.

examples.text: Dankzij haar <w>kundige</w> leiding werd het project binnen de gestelde deadline succesvol afgerond.

target_lang_translations.en: Thanks to her <w>competent</w> leadership, the project was successfully completed within the set deadline.

target_lang_definitions.en: Able to apply skills and knowledge in an effective and competent manner.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: having the ability, skills, or power to do something effectively
having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully
having the necessary power, skill, or opportunity to do something
having or showing the knowledge, ability, or training to perform a certain activity well
